trigger: Defined after inspecting the frozen York result and its MTBS class composition.
claim_boundary: This study cannot replace, rescue, or modify the frozen moderate/high primary endpoint.

source_study.population_rule: Use each event's immutable frozen H3 list and sealed AlphaEarth/Sentinel-2 feature file. Do not replace events or select cells based on new outcomes.

targets.class_5_rule: Exclude increased-greenness pixels because class 5 is not ordered above class 4.

class_5_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity only. A zero weight does not imply that increased greenness is equivalent to no fire effect.

within_event_analysis.optical_oracle: For each target and event, take the larger of the matched dNBR and dNDVI Spearman correlations.
within_event_analysis.missing_target_rule: Report every frozen cell with zero class-1-through-4 denominator. Correlations use finite target-feature pairs; no event is replaced. Any event with fewer than 200 finite cells is reported as unavailable for that target.

tessera_secondary.rule: If the prespecified TESSERA feature files are locally available, recompute the same targets and contrasts on the same nine evaluable frozen populations. Preserve the documented missing event.

reporting.manuscript_role: Exploratory supplement or future-study motivation only.
